decision_reason: The system acted because the confirmed incident resolved IDs and dates against the data, passed handbook validators, and passed pre-flight checks on a sandbox copy of the enterprise. Additionally, the live world matched the planning baseline across 4 slot reads and 9 pool reads, and the auditor confirmed that all rescheduling, dealer notifications, and loaner allocations adhered to handbook policy rules.
